competitors.raw_snapshot: Claude Code CHANGELOG.md本轮新增九条版本，晚于baseline已知的2.1.269：2.1.270-2.1.278。其中与meee2锚点相关性最高的三处：(1) 2.1.275 VSCode Agent map迭代——'the pill counts running agents and turns red after a failure, the main agent stays in view while the map scrolls, and agents sort by state then end time'，是对baseline上一轮已计入alerts的Agent map功能的持续投入；(2) 2.1.271 artifact watching能力扩大——一个session可同时watch的已发布artifact数从5提升到10；(3) 2.1.274 artifact watching行为变更——其他地方发布的新版本不再打断当前turn，Claude转而从后续一次Artifact工具调用结果中获知。其余版本(2.1.267-2.1.278区间)绝大部分为可靠性修复、gateway/计费/权限配置、Claude Tag/Code Review企业向功能，未见新的产品定位表述。

changes.description: Claude Code 2.1.275在VSCode继续迭代Agent map：footer药丸显示运行中agent数、失败后变红，地图滚动时主agent保持可见，agent按状态再按结束时间排序
changes.evidence: 「Improved the agent map: the pill counts running agents and turns red after a failure, the main agent stays in view while the map scrolls, and agents sort by state then end time」
changes.meee2_relevance: 推断：这是baseline上一轮已识别的'peripheral式session/agent总览'功能(与meee2锚点1/3/5呼应)的连续迭代而非一次性尝试，说明Anthropic在自身生态位上持续投入'不切焦点即可总览agent图'的方向，值得meee2团队持续跟踪该功能是否进一步扩展到跨session/跨项目的总览能力

changes.description: Claude Code的Artifact工具'watching'机制本轮两处增强：可同时watch的已发布artifact数从5提升到10(2.1.271)；其他地方发布的新版本不再打断当前turn，Claude改为从后续Artifact工具调用结果中获知(2.1.274)
changes.evidence: 「Improved artifact watching: a session can now watch up to 10 published artifacts at once for republishes made elsewhere, up from 5」「Changed artifact watching in local sessions: a new version published elsewhere no longer starts a turn; Claude learns of it from a later Artifact tool result」

alerts.headline: Codex Remote全plan GA：手机QR配对已连接主机后成为remote面板，可不回到电脑前review progress、approve actions、起新任务，呼应meee2锚点5(peripheral式轻量入口)
alerts.evidence: 「Codex Remote is now generally available — use it from the ChatGPT mobile app to start or continue work on a connected Mac or Windows host, review progress, and approve actions from your phone.」
alerts.action_suggestion: 建议跟踪Codex Remote是否会从'对已配对单一主机的远程操控'演进为跨owner/跨工具的session可携带能力；同时可将其'轻量移动入口不打断当前工作'的思路与meee2菜单栏peripheral层(F9等)做对照，评估交互效率差异。

alerts.headline: Claude Code持续迭代Agent map(peripheral式session总览)与Artifact watching机制(跨session artifact live同步)，均为对meee2核心锚点方向的连续工程投入
alerts.evidence: 「Improved the agent map: the pill counts running agents and turns red after a failure, the main agent stays in view while the map scrolls...」「Improved artifact watching: a session can now watch up to 10 published artifacts at once for republishes made elsewhere, up from 5」
alerts.action_suggestion: 建议meee2团队评估自身peripheral层(菜单栏)与descriptive canvas在'session总览颗粒度'和'跨session artifact live同步能力'上相对Claude Code Agent map/Artifact watching的领先窗口是否在缩小，作为路线图优先级参考。

alerts.headline: GitHub Copilot新增Sentry canvas，与上轮Jira canvas同构，'外部工具数据拉入canvas+AI跨调查/实现/PR'已连续两周复现，显示这是系统性产品线而非一次性实验
alerts.evidence: 「Users can review errors and stack traces with related context, then work with Copilot to investigate the cause, validate a fix, and prepare a pull request.」
alerts.action_suggestion: 建议下轮核实该canvas模式是否已扩展到除Jira、Sentry外的更多第三方工具，以及是否具备live同步(而非一次性带入)能力，评估其对meee2锚点3/4差异化优势的收窄速度，并据此调整meee2跨工具pull(F9)能力的对外沟通优先级。

alerts.headline: Linear Loops新增'响应更广泛workspace activity+编辑文档+post到Slack'，触及meee2锚点3(descriptive-first)与锚点4(跨工具artifact push)
alerts.evidence: 「Loops are recurring agent workflows for teams. They now respond to more workspace activity, including changes to initiatives, projects, and cycles. They can also edit Linear documents and post updates to Slack.」
alerts.action_suggestion: 建议跟踪Loops是否从'活动触发的单向自动化post'演进为可交互、双向的跨工具artifact同步，作为meee2锚点3/4差异化窗口的观察点之一。
